[Thinking]
**Joining CDS Hooks**

I'm thrilled to have joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. Having worked with the standard since 2017, I'm eager to contribute to its continued advancement. I've initiated a call to action for current users to share their implementations on the wiki.

**Contributing to CDS Hooks**

I'm now actively contributing to the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. My focus is on gathering community insights and promoting adoption. I'm encouraging practitioners to share their work on the wiki and offering freelance consulting for those new to the standard.
[/Thinking]

Here are a few options for your LinkedIn post, ranging from professional and reflective to short and direct.

### Option 1: Professional & Reflective (Best for showing thought leadership)
I am thrilled to share that I have officially been named a member of the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee (PMC)**! 🚀

My journey with CDS Hooks began back in 2017. Over the last seven years, I’ve seen firsthand how this standard has transformed clinical decision support by bringing real-time, context-aware insights directly into the clinician's workflow. 

Helping shape the future of this standard is an honor, and I’m incredibly excited to work alongside the community to move CDS Hooks forward.

**Two quick things for the community:**

1️⃣ **Are you already using CDS Hooks?** We want to see where the standard is in the wild! Please take a moment to add your implementation to our community registry here: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

2️⃣ **Thinking about implementing but don't know where to start?** I am currently available as a freelance consultant to help organizations navigate the complexities of implementation, integration, and strategy. Feel free to DM me!

Looking forward to this next chapter in the interoperability journey. 

#CDSHooks #HL7 #HealthIT #Interoperability #HealthTech #CDS #Informatics

***

### Option 2: Brief & Action-Oriented (Best for high engagement)
Big news! After working with the standard since 2017, I’ve officially joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee.**

I’ve always believed that CDS Hooks is one of the most practical tools we have for improving the provider experience and patient outcomes. I’m eager to help lead the standard into its next phase of growth.

**Current Users:** Please help us document the impact of the standard by adding your implementation to the wiki: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

**Future Users:** If you aren’t using CDS Hooks yet but want to explore how it can fit into your product or clinical roadmap, I am available for freelance consulting. Let’s talk about how I can help you get up to speed.

#HealthIT #CDSHooks #HL7 #FHIR #ClinicalDecisionSupport #Consulting

***

### Option 3: "The Full Circle" (Best for personal branding)
From my first encounter with CDS Hooks in 2017 to joining the **Project Management Committee** today—it’s been quite a ride! 

I’m excited to step into this role and help drive the evolution of the standard. Our goal is to make clinical decision support more seamless, scalable, and impactful than ever before.

**Want to help?** 
If your organization is already utilizing CDS Hooks, please add your implementation to our public wiki so the community can celebrate (and learn from) your work: https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

**Need a guide?**
Implementing interoperability standards can be daunting. If you’re looking to adopt CDS Hooks and need expert guidance, I’m available for freelance consulting to help you build, test, and deploy effectively.

Onward! 🚀

#CDSHooks #Interoperability #HL7 #HealthInnovation #FreelanceConsultant

***

**Pro-tip for LinkedIn:** 
* **Tag HL7** or other colleagues you know in the PMC. 
* **Add a photo** of a CDS Hooks architecture diagram or a screenshot of the GitHub page to increase the post's visibility in the algorithm!
